classification.III: optional specialized transfer, not a contracted universal theorem

entries.title: Actual intervention atom reification
entries.existing_foundation: X1.TypedModels.inducedKernel_atom_entry proves baseline typed atoms; Comparison.lean defines Jaction/Jupdate/Jjoint
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Derive finite rational entries for ALL 3 actual interventions in both modes and connect them to J.intervention.apply.inducedKernel on all 18 states.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Identical physical P; alpha-P-U order; old-world learner update; reset affects next memory only.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Corrupt world row, old/new-world update order, action timing, reset, and intervention name; proof must be tied to typed J.

entries.title: Finite-horizon rational reflection
entries.existing_foundation: FiniteOutputs.lean proves primitiveTerminal_eq_kernelTerminal for baseline, and baselineProperty_eq_kernelTerminal for all typed models
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Bridge time-three kernelTerminal for baseline and ALL intervened kernels to exact rational finite recursions, and certify all nine initial rows.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Same predeclared property P(X_3=true), terminal re-entry allowed; no killed-kernel substitution.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: 18-state exhaustive exact rational row checks; perturb one value / wrong horizon; compare to independent Python paths.

entries.title: All six original numerical margins
entries.existing_foundation: constitutiveEffect_eq_finiteEffect and constitutiveMargin_eq_finiteInf prove exact semantic correspondence
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Entire nine-start comparison B1; show lower bounds at all starts and attainment at a genuine start; no Exact-GR/PR promotion.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Exact negatives for dropping one start; show E all starts tie; learner minima q=(0,0) for action/joint, q=(2,2) for update.

entries.title: Unrestricted discounted-strategy verification
entries.existing_foundation: MPECertificate.lean proves both-player Bellman, pure/mixed one-shot, support; typed E uses same world
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove candidate discounted value and no profitable unilateral nonanticipating history-dependent behavioral deviation, with genuine expected-payoff/path bridge.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Fix observed information incl state/action histories; bounded rewards, beta=9/10, opponent baseline fixed, off-equilibrium starts, stage payoff availability (actions not on state path).
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Finite-horizon Bellman dominance telescopes; tail bound; optimality for every allowed policy and both players; failure of unbounded or clairvoyant strategies outside class.

entries.title: Strict opponent-locked MA2 feasibility and resolution
entries.existing_foundation: ProtocolWitnesses.lean proves broader nonstrict anchor example, strict MA1, and a deterministic-recording obstruction
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Either give a valid pair of strict baseline-agreeing OL anchors with distinct intervened full path laws, OR prove a general impossibility for the exactly declared strict subclass and record corrected claim status.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Anchor factorization through own S2 and permissible exogenous S0; common update cannot launder treated action; baseline-support agreement and reachable states exact.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Reject reactive anchorWorld, endogenous public clock, baseline-support undercoverage and inadmissible anchors; distinguish witness from impossibility proof.

entries.title: Geometric projected-prefix TV envelope
entries.existing_foundation: ApproxPrefix.lean proves TV_T<=min(1,T*eta); EventTVCalculus covers triangle/product operations
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove TV_T <= 1-(1-eta)^T in an explicitly measurable subclass with genuine shared-mass or coupling induction.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Defect bounds on every fine row incl counterfactual-reachable; typed q, matched starts; do not assume projected process is Markov.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Counterexample for non-Markov fine projection, eta=0/1, and vacuous horizons; prove common-mass measurability, not just analytic telescoping.

entries.title: Coupling W1 = Lipschitz-dual bridge
entries.existing_foundation: ContractiveOccupation.lean proves bounds for W1DualLE over bounded measurable 1-Lipschitz tests
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove Kantorovich–Rubinstein identification with coupling W1, or a sound one-way comparison sufficient for each desired statement.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Add appropriate Polish/Radon/finite first-moment premises; handle unbounded metrics without silently requiring global sup-norm <=1.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Atomic finite examples; metric test classes; no false TV-to-W1 equivalence on unbounded metrics.

entries.title: Invariant-law existence and uniqueness
entries.existing_foundation: Existing contraction assumes invariant pi and pi-tilde and finite initial dual gap
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove existence/uniqueness of invariant laws under an explicit complete metric/Feller/contractive or finite-state irreducible subclass.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: No existence from invariance identity alone; decide whether both compared kernels contract or only baseline K does.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Identity/multiclass countermodels without hypotheses; chain convergence with independently established invariant law.

entries.title: Primitive or sufficient-condition contraction certificates
entries.existing_foundation: ContractivePerturbation assumes IsW1Contraction; current A3 proof does not derive it
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Establish explicit sufficient conditions such as finite-space Doeblin/Dobrushin or metric coupling which imply the actually encoded dual contraction.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: TV contraction does not imply unqualified W1 contraction on unbounded metrics; include diameter or direct metric bound.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Small finite kernels that do/not contract; check rho<1 as proved data, not relabeled input.

entries.title: Four genuine full-path ergodic factorizations
entries.existing_foundation: occupationMargin_robust assumes all four psi(pathLaw_y)=F(h_#pi) identities on B1
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Derive factorization from a certified ergodic/occupation convergence theorem in a suitable subclass for original baseline, its intervention, perturbed baseline, and perturbed intervention.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Correct start quantifiers, measurable Lipschitz descriptor and property functional; do not infer path values from invariant laws without ergodicity.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Mixed-class and nonergodic counterexample; four-process exhaustive hypotheses and direct original property equality.

entries.title: Primitive metric kernel error to W1 defect
entries.existing_foundation: A2 derives primitive row event-TV; KantorovichTV.lean ALREADY proves bounded-diameter dual W1 <= D*TV and unbounded-metric noncontrol; A3 assumes row W1DualLE defects
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove a typed alpha/P/U-to-row metric defect certificate (or coupling certificate) with the correct Lipschitz and/or diameter premises; reuse rather than reprove the bounded-diameter conversion.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Changed P across compared models is model error, not a strategic intervention within each model; no universal TV to W1 on unbounded metrics.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Degenerate/large-diameter counterexamples, off-graph and unreachable baseline rows, stage-order mutation.
entries.dependencies: A3-K01 for coupling form; A2 primitive laws

entries.title: Augmented-state residence Bellman sufficiency
entries.existing_foundation: ResidenceEvent and ResidenceValue prove literal path event and optimum over deterministic full-history policies
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define compact state (physical y, streak/clock, completed flag, time) and prove evaluator and optimal value equal existing full-history one.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: m transitions = m+1 observations; starting target counts; retries; entry vs completion deadline; no physical absorbing rewrite.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Hitting-vs-residence counterexample; time-zero, m=0, retrial, off-by-one, full-history equality and attainment.

entries.title: Sharper sequential primitive product TV
entries.existing_foundation: A2 PrimitiveTV proves capped additive delta_alpha+delta_P+delta_U
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Show delta_K<=1-(1-delta_alpha)(1-delta_P)(1-delta_U) by sequential common-part/coupling construction.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Measurable overlap at each stage under actual alpha-P-U sequence; uniform row bounds.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Examples saturating product; nonindependent stages; preserve off-graph rows.

entries.title: Localized/initial-law and numerical-output budgets
entries.existing_foundation: CQ1 finite path/output model-error transport is proved under stated global hypotheses
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Derive a separately specified reachable-state or initial-distribution sensitivity theorem, plus any further identified numerical-model uncertainty transport not already in PropertyErrors.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Do not silently replace true model margins by approximate reported outputs; control visit probability and initial law mismatch explicitly.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Counterexample with unvisited baseline row becoming intervention-reachable; adversarial initial-law shifts.

entries.title: Nonfinite/whole-path output transport
entries.existing_foundation: ApproxMargin.lean covers finite-prefix TV-Lipschitz properties only
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Build a property-level whole-path comparison with separately proved output-error budgets, if a relevant class admits it.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Non-Lipschitz tail/survival not stable under tiny TV errors; no automatic Exact-GR preservation.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Leakage counterexample; horizon dependence; missing property factorization.

entries.title: Conditional regime transfer under approximate quotient
entries.existing_foundation: Frozen theorem 7.4b handles exact matching; E1 approximate preserves scoped finite margins
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: In an explicit subclass, prove full original GR/PR correspondence only when independent invariance, convergence, basin/descriptor/relevance and lift gates are separately established.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: No theorem can promote Exact GR merely from eta>0 and positive margin.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Two-state leakage falsifier, non-saturated region, hidden descriptor, nonliftable initial laws.

entries.title: Swap treated player to player 2
entries.existing_foundation: TwoPlayerGenerator and protocolFamily treat player 1 only
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Formalize player-2 CL/OL typed replacements and the same actual canonical path/margin bounds.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Product coordinate swap must respect P and common S0; no silent symmetry with asymmetric player input.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Asymmetric worlds and private-update regression.

entries.title: General finite n-player product protocol
entries.existing_foundation: F1.1 encodes only two-player conditional product
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define finite-index action/update kernels and i-th-player interventions with measurable products and original family admissibility.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Subclassification explicitly product-conditional; correlated moves need separate treatment.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Reduce to n=2 and asymmetric n=3 examples, show same P and frozen update.

entries.title: Typed nonstationary/open-loop clock
entries.existing_foundation: Current anchor clock is Python-only; original update input has no arbitrary time schedule
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Embed clock in an actually updated permissible state coordinate and prove horizon-indexed anchor behavior under canonical path laws.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: No access to disallowed player-1/action/world channels in strict protocol; common clock only if exogenous.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Period-2 action witness; static-anchor false positive; excluded endogenous clock.

entries.title: Feasible opponent-anchor menus
entries.existing_foundation: F1 declared intervention families do not encode player-action feasibility
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Give a typed feasible-action predicate and prove closed/open generators preserve supported feasible actions.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Feasible graph measured and component-wise; nonempty menus.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Force illegal action and reject; all legal actions give an admitted anchor.

entries.title: General nonreactivity/exogeneity characterization
entries.existing_foundation: IsStrictlyNonReactive and IsExogenousCommon give a sufficient autonomous menu
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Develop a necessary-and-sufficient criterion (if possible) for counterfactual opponent independence under declared information flow.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Do not equate local nonworld-reading with absence of endogenous S0 response.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Path through S0 encodes treated action; random shared-coin positive example.

entries.title: Correlated nonproduct strategic generators
entries.existing_foundation: correlatedLaw_ne_prod proves chosen correlation not product-representable
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Formalize explicit correlated/private-public signal subclass or alternative joint kernels with declared shared information.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: No universal factorization without sufficient latent variable/state.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: A perfectly correlated Boolean law, independence falsifier, shared exogenous coin.

entries.title: Identified causal-adaptation decomposition
entries.existing_foundation: AdaptationBound establishes a metric difference, not causal mediation
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Only with a separately specified structural counterfactual/identification model, prove a causal decomposition or formal nonidentification result.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Require modularity, support, anchor legitimacy and observational regime; never rename protocol gap causal effect.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Distinct SCMs with same observed law but different mediation; compare intervention semantics.

entries.title: Randomized-history-policy sufficiency
entries.existing_foundation: D2 currently optimizes over deterministic HistoryPolicy
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove a deterministic optimal policy suffices for finite fully observed expected residence reward under explicitly allowed randomized policies, or characterize when not.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Declare behavioral randomization model and independence; avoid robust minmax where mixing helps.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: One-model finite expected reward vs model-uncertain robust counterexample.

entries.title: First-ever-entry residence semantics
entries.existing_foundation: D2 successful run may start at any attempted visit, not necessarily first hit
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Create separate first-ever-entry-only objective and corresponding event/recursion, proving difference from retryable objective.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Time-zero entry, deadlines and no retries must be explicitly defined.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Initial hit followed by failure and later success rejected by first-entry objective.

entries.title: Combined reach/avoid/residence optimization
entries.existing_foundation: D2 handles residence and separately reuses goal-before-forbidden
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define one finite-path event with forbidden precedence and residence, prove dynamic programming value and canonical event bridge.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Freeze whether forbidden entry before/after success counts; no accidental absorbing dynamics.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Cases with forbidden crossing after partial residence and simultaneous target/forbidden memberships.

entries.title: Hard risk-constrained optimal policy
entries.existing_foundation: D2.ORDER proves a one-decision counterexample, not general constrained optimization
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove finite policy optimization with P(forbidden)<=rho and success objective, with exact risk state or appropriate LP/occupation certificate.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Hard risk is distinct from failure probability and value may require randomized controls.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Reject unconstrained optimizer with excess risk; rational admissible optimal policy.

entries.title: Robust dynamic programming with quantified nature
entries.existing_foundation: D2.ORDER separates sup_pi inf_K from inf_K sup_pi in one-shot witness
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove policy-state robust recursion in a precisely specified rectangular model; model-commitment/nonrectangular cases need separate methods.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Nature observation/order and model switching information explicitly modeled; avoid interchanging quantifiers.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: One-decision minmax counterexample; nonrectangular uncertainty failing local Bellman.

entries.title: Partial observation and belief-state reduction
entries.existing_foundation: D1/D2 use fully observed states/histories
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define observation kernels, belief filtering and prove any claimed belief-state sufficiency/optimality theorem.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Identifiability and policy access to observations; no future observations.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Two histories with same observation but different hidden state; compare belief-path laws.

entries.title: Finite-to-infinite reach-and-stay or viability
entries.existing_foundation: Finite m residence theorem does not imply infinite persistence
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove a conditional infinite-retention/switching objective under controlled invariance/viability or almost-sure tail conditions.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Infinite stochastic leakage invalidates naive finite-horizon limit argument.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Tiny-leak chain with finite residence success but infinite survival zero.

entries.title: Grammar-block adaptive control
entries.existing_foundation: D0/D1 action selection controls only; Lane B blocks have separate admissibility
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define block control menus with admissible joint alpha/U semantics, then prove typed path/optimum correspondence.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: All block constraints and P preservation maintained; no implicit policy interpretation as fixed intervention.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Overlapping patches rejected; synergistic joint-only test.

entries.title: Optimize class-entry or asymptotic observed family
entries.existing_foundation: C2/C5 have recurrent class and observed-family limit laws; D2 finite goal constraints
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Prove finite controlled class selection/occupation-target objective and policy verification (under valid stationary or product-clock assumptions).
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Asymptotic law vs finite hitting; predeclare target family and supports.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Same descriptor target from distinct physical classes; class weights vs occupation share.

entries.title: Total generic rational stationary reference solver
entries.existing_foundation: C11 checkStationaryFamily_sound and Python Gaussian solver; C10 total Cramer theorem is ALREADY PROVED
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Formalize a deterministic referenceStationaryFamily(K) and prove checkStationaryFamily K (referenceStationaryFamily K)=true for every valid nonempty rational K.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Need constructive exact stationary vectors on each BSCC, rational linear-algebra nonsingularity and proof against genuine typed stationary measures.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Wrong class, duplicate, missing class, singular rows, periodic class and corrupted rational weights.

entries.title: General-state multiple-limit classification
entries.existing_foundation: C2–C5 finite canonical class limits/sharp family and original Exact-GR recovery are PROVED
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Develop conditional nonfinite-state/random-set/weak-cluster-point regime family semantics only with tightness/measurability/convergence hypotheses.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: No theorem guarantees occupational convergence in arbitrary measurable or infinite-state systems.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Growing-block nonconvergence, noncompact escaping mass and observed-collapse countermodels.

entries.title: Overlapping and conflicting component blocks
entries.existing_foundation: B1–B13 verified for disjoint physical atom banks, admissible finite block grammar
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Specify conflict-resolution or compatibility algebra for overlapping alpha/U patches and prove path-law/constitutive preservation or counterexample.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Do not assume independently admissible components compose under overlap.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Same row patched two ways, order-dependence and infeasible joined blocks.

entries.title: General grammar lattice / minimality transport
entries.existing_foundation: Current B provides order-isomorphic and refinement-specific minimality preservation plus counterexamples
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Characterize stronger transport/closure theorems for broader permitted blocks, if structurally sound.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Do not assume uniqueness of minimal block or arbitrary bijection preserving inclusion.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: AND two incomparable minima, XOR nonmonotonicity, equal margins yet different subblock ordering.

entries.title: Separate genuine economic Exact-GR/PR positive witness
entries.existing_foundation: X1 proves replete B leaks and h=x constant there; Lane B has other positive constructed regime witnesses
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Construct a NEW preregistered finite economic model with independently proved all Exact-GR, descriptor, basin, grounding and actual constitutive gates; retain old X1 negative witness untouched.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Cannot repair the fixed X1 B merely with margin arithmetic; needs new model or an independently frozen new specification.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Leakage, descriptor degeneracy, invalid singleton B1 and chosen ex-post region counterexamples.

entries.title: Scalar-defect transfer
entries.existing_foundation: Finite Weil–CCM scalar-defect working paper in paper/supporting/specialized_theory
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define a matching Permansson representation class and prove the low-rank/scalar defect reduction in that class.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Requires explicit linear/quadratic rigidity assumptions; not universal GR/PR.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Counterexample without rigidity; direct equality with frozen typed interventions.
entries.status: OPTIONAL / NOT PROPOSED AS UNIVERSAL THEOREM

entries.title: Persistent finite detection transfer
entries.existing_foundation: Finite off-critical zero detection working paper
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Define nested legal approximants and prove detection transfer under continuity and nesting assumptions.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: No blanket finite detection for discontinuous infinite objects.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Failure under poor nesting/continuity.
entries.status: OPTIONAL / NOT PROPOSED AS UNIVERSAL THEOREM

entries.title: First-bad cubic quotient transfer
entries.existing_foundation: First-bad cubic rigidity working paper
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Derive successor quotient-dimension obstruction within an explicitly matched Permansson subclass.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Scalar only if quotient dimension equals one.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Higher-dimensional successor counterexample.
entries.status: OPTIONAL / NOT PROPOSED AS UNIVERSAL THEOREM

entries.title: Singular compatibility transfer
entries.existing_foundation: Zero-shift source rigidity working paper
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Formalize kernel/range compatibility when a relevant predecessor/response map is singular.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Do not apply unjustified inverse/pseudoinverse.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Singular matrix violating range inclusion.
entries.status: OPTIONAL / NOT PROPOSED AS UNIVERSAL THEOREM

entries.title: Quadratic Gram-witness transfer
entries.existing_foundation: Explicit Gram witness working paper
entries.missing_mathematical_closure: Transfer separating direction and perturbation margin in a defined signed-rank-one quadratic subclass.
entries.proof_hypotheses_boundary: Requires Gram witness and class-specific quadratic assumptions.
entries.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Indefinite/non-rank-one counterexample.
entries.status: OPTIONAL / NOT PROPOSED AS UNIVERSAL THEOREM
